title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Given a string containing only parentheses characters, determine whether every opening bracket is closed by the correct type in the correct order.

editor_note.idea: Push opening brackets and verify that each closing bracket matches the latest unmatched opening bracket.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: A stack naturally models nested and last-opened-first-closed structures.
editor_note.edge_cases: An empty string is valid. A closing bracket cannot be processed when the stack is empty.
editor_note.pitfalls: Using a queue would break the matching order.
